status: Three illustrative concepts, no final route selected

routes.title: The Shared Handi
routes.meaning: Two people cradle one handi. Their curved arms embrace the vessel; rising rice turns the shared meal into the centre of the symbol.
routes.promise: A generous meal, made to share.
routes.grammar: Use spare human gestures, rice plants and vessels to show preparing and sharing a meal. Keep a simple horizontal storytelling band on packaging; leave the main logo uncluttered.
routes.boundary: A contemporary folk-inspired proposal. It is not labelled authentic Saura, Warli or an artisan-made identity. The stock reference is inspiration only and has not been reproduced.
routes.type: Sturdy, approachable sans lettering; a plain sans-serif for dish information.
routes.use: Strongest route for a local, warm identity with scope for illustrated walls, bags and menus.

routes.title: The Dum Garden
routes.meaning: A handi grows into a balanced flowering garden. The pot identifies cooking; the rising grains and botanical rhythm suggest layers of aroma.
routes.grammar: Extend the logo’s flower-and-leaf forms into generous botanical borders and large cropped panels. Use a quiet label field so floral detail never competes with dish names.
routes.boundary: Mughal botanical painting is courtly art, rather than a tribal style. This is a modern interpretation of its floral rhythm, with no royal-recipe or historical-lineage claim.
routes.type: Softly flared display capitals with a simple sans-serif for menus and order information.
routes.use: Best for a richly illustrated packaging world with a more composed restaurant feel.

routes.title: The Dum Keeper
routes.meaning: A cook holds a handi close, with the face and aroma shaped through negative space. The gesture communicates care and anticipation of the meal.
routes.grammar: Use the host as a recognisable recurring character on labels and social posts. Supporting illustrations can show serving and sharing; keep the face, pot and main pose consistent.
routes.boundary: An original illustrated host. The supplied chef references informed negative-space simplicity; their specific silhouettes, moustaches and hats are not the identity.
routes.type: Rounded sans lettering with a clear functional sans-serif for menu copy.
routes.use: Best for immediate food-service recognition and a compact, friendly symbol.
